claims.text: Selman Marrakech is a palace at the foot of the Atlas Mountains in Marrakech.

findings.quote: At the foot of the Atlas Mountains in Marrakech stands a palace of singular charm

claims.text: The Arab-Moorish inspired palace bears the signature of French architect and designer Jacques Garcia.

findings.quote: this Arab-Moorish inspired palace, where the horse reigns supreme, proudly bears the signature of the renowned French architect and designer Jacques Garcia

claims.text: The hotel was conceived as a homage to the purebred Arabian horse.

findings.quote: A vibrant homage to the purebred Arabian horse, the finest of all horse breeds, Selman Marrakech was envisioned by its founders

claims.text: Private villas sit within the hotel's gardens, with Arab-Moorish design by Jacques Garcia.

findings.quote: Nestled within the hotel's gardens, five private villas elevate the excellence of this haven, embodying the full sensuality of Arab-Moorish design, masterfully orchestrated by Jacques Garcia

claims.text: The villas span 580 to 700 square meters.

findings.quote: these exclusive gems, spanning 580 to 700 square meters

claims.text: Each suite has a bedroom, a living room and one or two terraces overlooking the pool and Andalusian gardens.

findings.quote: each suite comprises a bedroom, a living room, and one or two terraces overlooking the majestic pool and Andalusian gardens

claims.text: The Suites and Suites Premier span 120 square meters and combine Jacques Garcia's style with Moroccan interiors.

findings.quote: Symbols of the union between the contemporary elegance of Jacques Garcia's signature and the refinement of Moroccan interiors, our Suites span 120 square meters.
Symbols of the union between the contemporary elegance of Jacques Garcia's signature and the refinement of Moroccan interiors, our Suites Premier span 120 square meters.

claims.text: Deluxe Premier Rooms are 55 square meters with views of the pool and the Andalusian gardens, detailed by Jacques Garcia.

findings.quote: Offering breathtaking views of the 80m long pool and the Andalusian gardens of the hotel, these 55-square-meter havens unveil a subtle Oriental refinement interpreted in every detail by Jacques Garcia.

claims.text: The Chenot Spa covers 1,200 square meters and recalls the heated baths of old Istanbul.

findings.quote: The Chenot Spa at Selman Marrakech covers a sumptuous 1200 mètres carrés reminiscent of the heated baths of antique Istanbul

claims.text: The spa has seven treatment rooms, four hydrotherapy rooms, a hydro-massage pool, two heated outdoor pools, two hammams, a gym and a boutique.

findings.quote: There are seven treatment rooms, four hydrotherapy rooms, a hydro-massage pool, two heated outdoor pools, two hammams, a gym and a boutique for essentials.

claims.text: The Chenot Spa offers 3, 5 or 10-day retreats, including the Chenot Relax Programme.

findings.quote: Chenot SPA offers a variety of 3, 5 or 10-day retreats including the Chenot Relax Programme designed to detoxify, energize, regenerate and destress the nervous system.

claims.text: Assyl serves Moroccan cuisine prepared by an exclusively female brigade.

findings.quote: Curated under the expertise of an exclusively female brigade, the Assyl restaurant invites you to embark on a journey through this ancestral culinary art
At the table of Assyl, these culinary treasures of Morocco are savored

claims.text: Guests can explore the hotel's private stables, where Selman Arabians are bred.

findings.quote: Explore our private stables and immerse yourself in the captivating universe of Selman Arabians breeding

claims.text: Signature experiences include a dinner in the stables, basics of dressage and working in liberty with the horses.

findings.quote: Signature dinner in the stables
Basics of dressage
Working in liberty

claims.text: The hotel is one of six palaces in the world with a Chenot Spa.

findings.quote: Our luxury hotel is one of the 6 palaces in the world to have a Chenot Spa.

claims.text: Le Pavillon's Sunday brunch includes a parade of the hotel's Arabian horses.

findings.quote: Every Sunday, Le Pavillon orchestrates one of the most exquisite brunches in the Ochre City
while enjoying a horse parade featuring the hotel's prestigious Arabian Horses

claims.text: Golf courses and trekking in the Atlas Mountains are nearby.

findings.quote: nearby golf courses, horse riding experiences or trekking in the near Atlas mountains

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the hotel is located outside the central Marrakech medina area.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.
